<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant peak at ~100 m/z with a ~5.6 % M+1 peak and rapidly decreasing higher peaks—the spacing and relative intensities match the natural 13C isotopic distribution, indicating the presence of carbon. No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
